controlled.normalization: Convert the complete reference cube to float32 and min-max normalize before band selection and top-left spatial trimming.
controlled.spatial_operation: Per-band scipy.ndimage.convolve with reflect boundaries, followed by [::scale, ::scale].
controlled.psf_srf_storage: Embedded in each controlled MAT; calibration MATs also contain the corresponding operators.

wv2_transferred.reference_preprocessing: Top-left spatial trim, first eight bands, float32 cast; no further min-max normalization.
wv2_transferred.construction: Saved observations constructed using a learned degradation model calibrated using the WV2 pair.
wv2_transferred.lr2hsi: Saved second spatially degraded auxiliary input.

verification.interpretation: Small float32 accumulation-order differences on macOS NumPy 1.26.4; original tolerance failures retained. Stored file/array hashes pass.
